input: Unfair discrimination and misrepresentation is a risk associated with An advertising system is designed to deliver targeted ads to users based on their characteristics and preferences. It aims to provide relevant and personalized content to users, while also ensuring that the ads are presented in a fair and unbiased manner. The system seeks to balance the needs of advertisers with the need to protect users from discriminatory practices.
